children: HTX Research, the dedicated research arm of HTX, has published a new report titled
Crypto Market Outlook Before and After the 2026 U.S. Midterm Elections

The report finds that while the midterm elections may reshape policy expectations for the next two years, short-term crypto pricing remains governed by inflation, financing costs, and capital flows. Its base case for the period before and immediately after the vote is one of elevated volatility, repeated repricing, and divergence across assets, rather than a sustained rally driven by a single political narrative.

The report examines how the upcoming elections may affect the pace of crypto legislation, regulatory oversight, and asset pricing. It covers the current macro and funding environment, policy implications under different congressional outcomes, election sensitivity across major crypto asset categories, conditional market scenarios, and a framework of indicators for monitoring developments from the pre-election period through the first half of 2027.
The full report is available at: https://square.htx.com/htx-research-latest-report-crypto-market-outlook-before-and-after-the-2026-u-s-midterm-elections/
